description: The plot illustrates how BLEU score varies with Average Lagging (AL) for four methods, shown as separate lines. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” on a linear scale, spanning approximately from −1 to 7, with labeled ticks at 0, 2, 4, and 6. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” on a linear scale, ranging from 12 to 28 with labeled ticks every 2 units (12, 14, …, 28). The Consistency-CE line is drawn in light purple with circular markers and a dashed style, increasing from about 13 at AL ≈ −0.5 to about 26.5 at AL ≈ 7, with intermediate points near 19.8 (AL ≈ 1), 22.4 (AL ≈ 4), and 24.8 (AL ≈ 6). The Inconsistency-CE line is purple with square markers and a dashed style, rising from about 20.0 at AL ≈ 1 to about 27.0 at AL ≈ 7, passing through roughly 22.6 (AL ≈ 2), 24.9 (AL ≈ 4), and 26.1 (AL ≈ 6). The Inconsistency-CE-MP line is blue with square markers and a dashed style, increasing from about 19.8 at AL ≈ 1 to about 27.2 at AL ≈ 7, with points around 22.7 (AL ≈ 2), 25.0 (AL ≈ 4), and 26.0 (AL ≈ 6). The Consistency-Bi line is red with star markers and a solid style, increasing from about 22.6 at AL ≈ −0.5 to about 27.8 at AL ≈ 7, with intermediate values near 24.2 (AL ≈ 1), 25.9 (AL ≈ 3.5–4), and 26.7 (AL ≈ 6).
